name: concord
description: Mini Discord para um grupo pequeno de amigos: salas de texto e voz, câmera, microfone e compartilhamento de tela com áudio.

scripts.setup: npm install && node scripts/setup.mjs && npm run build
scripts.build: node scripts/build-branding.mjs && npm run build -w client
scripts.desktop:dist: node scripts/build-branding.mjs && npm run dist --prefix desktop
scripts.dist: npm run server:dist && npm run desktop:dist
